137079: Power is a fiend, a dead body possessed by a devil. She is a Public Safety Devil Hunter who works (against her will) under Makima as a member of an experimental squad in Tokyo Special Division 4. She works alongside her partner Denji, and under supervision by Aki Hayakawa.
137080: Makima is a Public Safety Devil Hunter, who took Denji as her human pet. She is one of the leading figures of Public Safety in Japan and has a considerable reputation among experienced Devil Hunters.
